_comment: Deterministic render settings for the plugin safety harness. mock.json is a real ESPN snapshot (2026 season, rounds 5-9 completed) plus synthetic practice/poles/latest-round seeds, so every screen renders offline with no network. freeze_time sits just after round 9 (Barcelona, race 2026-06-12); latest-round resolves to 9 (seeded), matching the cached qualifying/sprint/results keys, and no session window is open so no live badge appears. sizes covers narrow, wide, and the two tall panels (128x64, 256x64) plus the 192x48 wide-short rig, exercising the adaptive font-grid snapping and vertical centering. Golden images exist only for f1_upcoming: it renders a full static frame, whereas the seven scroll modes (standings/results/qualifying/practice/sprint/calendar) start with a blank scroll-in buffer so a single-frame capture is empty and not worth committing. Those modes are still covered by this harness's crash + overflow checks at every size; missing goldens are skipped, not failed.
